editorial:
Imagine finding out that the person you trust most in the world has been stealing from you for years. That is exactly what happens to Lennie, a sweet woman in her seventies who gets her world turned upside down when she realizes her own son has been committing a serious crime against her. It is a heavy start, but the movie does not stay in the dark. You will see Lennie struggle with her feelings of betrayal while trying to figure out who she even is anymore. The vibe is mostly quiet and emotional, focusing on how a person picks up the pieces when their family breaks their heart.

What really makes this work is the acting, which feels so real it almost hurts to watch. The pacing is slow, but it lets you feel every bit of Lennie's pain and eventual growth. While some might find it too sad, the bond she forms with a new friend gives you a reason to keep watching.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Lennie finally confronts her son in a quiet but powerful showdown. She does not let him manipulate her anymore and chooses to cut him out of her life to protect her peace. The twist is that her new friend was actually hired by a lawyer to help her recover her stolen money. The movie ends with Lennie starting a small business, showing she has finally found her strength and a new identity.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves powerful stories about family secrets and personal growth.
